# Morrowglass fieldbook

This is a wholly invented manufacturer of ceramic tiles, cups and demonstration pieces. Every number, role, product and convention in this bundle is synthetic. It is not an operating guide for a real kiln or evidence of any real approval.

## How the shelves are arranged
The shelves hold equipment notes, material records, inspection instructions, shipping instructions and studio records. This hub locates them; it does not set firing, grading, material or shipping requirements. Use the designated source for the relevant operation.

## Reading signals
Drafts are proposals. Deprecated sheets are historical. A recorded machine check is a fixture metadata signal, not evidence of human acceptance. A directory can age even when its wording remains precise. An index may omit recently filed sheets.
